description: A buy (USDC amount) or a sale (token amount) of a player token, paid from and credited to the ICARE Portfolio of the wallet: the quote, the minimum received, and the Portfolio action to sign with personal_sign over its digest, then to post with the signature to the ICARE relay. No gas for the wallet; the relay keeps the network fee in USDC.

amount.description: USDC to spend (buy) or tokens to sell (sell), digits with an optional decimal point

slippage.description: Accepted price move in percent, 2 by default

token.description: Token address or symbol, see icare_player_tokens

wallet.description: Address of the wallet that will sign

name: icare_token_prepare
title: Prepare a player token trade
